g.text: One box in front turns N servers into one address
Clients know ONE name. Servers can be added, removed,
restarted and replaced without anyone being told.
L4 routes on IP and port — fast, blind to content
L7 reads the request — can route by path, host, header
It's now the single point everything passes through,
so it needs its own redundancy — usually a pair with
a floating IP, or anycast above it.
